calls.klassReason: Names SPX, two explicit levels (7697/7720) as a rise target, and a future tense ('المتوقع يصعد'). Posted 02:21 UTC+3 on Mon 2026-09-21, before the US session; CFD feed showed 7664, cash SPX closed 7650.50 on Friday. Sentence 1 is retrospective (a prior call, not scoreable here). The 'negative target' sentence names no level and defers timing ('ببلغكم في حينه') — a hedge, not scoreable. The scoreable claim is the rise to the 7697–7720 zone.
calls.notes: Levels quoted on a CFD feed (BlackBull) ~14 pts above Friday's cash close; scored on cash SPX exactly as he stated them. The two levels form a zone; per PROTOCOL §3 each is scored separately and a partial is not rounded up to a hit. Chart attached was 1h; scored on daily bars per PROTOCOL §6.3.
